title: Measure tool-call batching per API message in token_audit
objective: A per-record count of tool calls reports 1.00 calls/message regardless of actual behaviour, because the harness splits one API message into one record per tool_use block. Grouping by message.id makes the real rate (1.9%) observable, and persisting it in the snapshot lets the next weekly run adjudicate whether batching improved without any hand-rolled analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Batching is grouped by message.id, not by transcript record
The markdown report shows batched share and calls per message
weekly.json carries tool_messages, batched_messages and batched_calls
A window with no tool calls does not divide by zero
100% branch coverage retained and no lint suppressions introduced
out_of_scope: Changing reconciled totals, cost weights, or the mtime-based window selection
Acting on the measurement (hooks/nudges live in ~/.claude, not this repo)
verifier: python3 -m pytest python_pkg/token_audit/tests; python3 -m coverage report (100%); pre-commit run --files <changed>; python3 -m python_pkg.token_audit --days 7 --no-write
